title: Fix rig bone selection pivots and rename body pelvis root
description: Fix SceneView rig-bone manipulation so the selected generated bone is the sole manipulation target, and keep the compact body root semantic name as body_root. Unity 6.5 does not permit assignment to Tools.handlePosition, so the previous attempted handle-position override is removed. The remaining acceptance gate is live Unity verification of the built-in transform tool or, if that still fails, a dedicated EditorTool/Handle implementation.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: ROUND 4 USER COMPILATION REPRO. Unity 6.5 reports CS0200: Tools.handlePosition is read-only. The prior implementation attempted to assign this property, so that approach is invalid for the target Unity API.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: ROUND 4 REPAIR. Removed the unsupported RigBoneTransformHandle.cs implementation rather than retaining a dead/non-compiling abstraction. The earlier single-selection correction in RigDebugView remains. The task stays InProgress because live verification is still required; if Unity's standard transform handle remains incorrectly positioned after the compile fix, the correct next implementation is a dedicated SceneView EditorTool/custom RotationHandle rather than another Tools.handlePosition hack.
